content.thinking: The trans structure is `[((97,97), 1)]` — so `ranges, target = ((97,97), 1)` → ranges = (97,97) which is a tuple of two ints, not a tuple of tuples. I wrote `((ord(node.low), ord(node.high)), accept)` which makes ranges = (97, 97) — needs to be `(((lo,hi),), accept)`. Let me fix the Range branch to use a nested tuple.

def rand_pattern(depth=0):
